title: refactor: consolidate model entries
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Consolidates Trellis 2, Perplexity Sonar, Grok 4.20, Gemini Flash Lite, and Gemini Flash variant rows into parameter-driven canonical entries.
- Keeps retired IDs as identity-only aliases: they only resolve the canonical entry and never imply parameters; explicit resolution, search-context, search-tool, and reasoning parameters select behavior.
- Keeps the independent gemini-search model unchanged on its existing route.
- Migrates stored API-key allowlists to canonical IDs with bounded, idempotent, order-preserving deduplication.

Deployment: apply Enter migration 0044 before deploying the Gen registry changes.

Tests:
- Gen and Enter typechecks
- 62 text routing/transform, 28 request/3D, 36 tracking/permissions, and 32 pricing/migration tests
- D1 migration coverage with 10,000 unaffected keys, all 24 retired IDs, malformed/unrestricted rows, ordering, deduplication, and idempotency
- 200,001-row SQLite stress run: zero retired IDs remained, 0.78s
- Local Trellis query, cache, billing, and alias paths
- Production smoke tests for canonical Gemini, independent gemini-search, Perplexity low/high, and Grok reasoning routes

Production Trellis reached InferencePort but the provider returned HTTP 524; the equivalent local end-to-end path passes.

gist.headline: Many labels, one hive
gist.blurb: The model garden got a careful pruning: Trellis 2, Perplexity Sonar, Grok 4.20, and Gemini Flash variants now grow from canonical entries. Old labels still lead to the right flower; parameters decide which petals open.
gist.summary: Consolidated Trellis 2, Perplexity Sonar, Grok 4.20, Gemini Flash Lite, and Gemini Flash variant rows into parameter-driven canonical models, while preserving retired IDs as identity-only aliases and migrating API-key allowlists to canonical IDs.
gist.impact: Existing retired model IDs continue resolving safely, while explicit search-context, search-tool, and reasoning parameters consistently select Perplexity, Grok, and Gemini behavior; the standalone gemini-search route remains unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden being organized into a few well-labeled central planters, with many small old plant tags gently pointing toward the same canonical flowers. Polli acts as the careful gardener with a tiny clipboard, while a CRT monitor robot happily maps old labels to the correct plants; vines made of API-key tags show that existing access follows the new paths without losing its place.
